## SimulationAuthorization type

How the caller expresses a token authorization that must be in place before the main transactions run. The package decides HOW to simulate each one: - "approval" → prepend tx as-is - "signature" → today: encode approve(spender, amount); future: ecrecover override?

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type SimulationAuthorization = {
    type: "approval";
    transaction: SimulationTransaction;
} | {
    type: "signature";
    token: Address;
    spender: Address;
    amount?: bigint;
};
```
**References:** [SimulationTransaction](./evm-simulation.simulationtransaction.md)
